title: Solution Architect

ING is looking for ahands-on technical leaderto architect and drive the development of our enterpriseProcess Orchestration Platform. This is not just an architecture role—you will be deeply involved inengineering decisions,coding standards, andplatform evolution, ensuring scalability and reliability for thousands of internal consumers.
The teamYou will be joining the Retail & Banking Technology (R&BT) - Workflow Management team. ING has thousands of engineers across the globe, the purpose of R&BT is to make their lives easier, as well as to get to a level of interoperability that makes reuse of components the standard. The Channels & Journey Orchestration tribe of R&BT is responsible for building, deploying, and managing services that own the customer experience and orchestrate the journey with ING’s products and services. The key responsibility area of this position is to drive the architecture and implementation for our process orchestration platform that supports all aspects of process automation, human workflow and case management.
Roles and responsibilitiesYou willdefine and build the backbone of our automation strategy, shaping a platform that accelerates business processes across a complex enterprise. Your leadership will influence technical direction, guide engineers, and deliver a product that sets new standards for process orchestration within ING. You will be pivotal in scaling the team towards a high performing and autonomous team.
